sources.name: BloFin withdrawal costs (decentralised.news Crypto Friction Cost Index 2026-05 + datawallet network-switch testing 2026-06 + walletreviewer 2026-06)
sources.note: BloFin publishes no fixed table — withdrawals are dynamic network cost pass-through with no exchange markup. Measured: BTC ~0.0002 BTC, USDT TRC-20 flat ~1 USDT, ETH on Arbitrum/Optimism ~$0.5-2, ERC-20 'a few dollars'. ERC-20 stablecoin/ETH figures below are 2026-09 estimates flagged per route. BloFin supports USDT/USDC across Tron/Ethereum/Solana/BNB Chain/Arbitrum; only the modeled routes are listed. No direct fiat cash-out rail — fiat returns via third-party providers only.

sources.note: BTC semi-fixed 0.0005 (min 0.001, no Lightning); ETH official dynamic, third-party range 0.005-0.03; USDT ERC-20 only at ~20 USDT (no TRC-20/Solana); USDC dynamic with multi-chain support (Solana/Arbitrum/Polygon/Optimism/Avalanche/Stellar).

sources.name: Bitvavo withdrawal fees (official schedule is dynamic per blockchain congestion; third-party 2026 snapshots: bitcoin.diy 2026-05-28 ~0.00005 BTC, freenance 2026-09-03 ~0.00006 BTC)
sources.note: BTC on-chain only — no Lightning payouts; typical reference ~0.00005 BTC (≈$3.86 at the 2026-09-12 snapshot), can rise during congestion. One third-party snapshot (bitbo) listed a much lower 0.0000063 BTC, treated as an unconfirmed low outlier. EUR SEPA cash-outs are FREE (≤€25k/day for standard verification). Only the BTC route is modeled v0.42 — Bitvavo lists 390-450+ assets but per-asset dynamic fees were not individually verified; re-check at withdrawal time.

sources.name: Finst fee schedule (official finst.com/en/fees, schedule valid 2026-07-23; verified 2026-09-13)
sources.note: Crypto withdrawal = variable network fee (pass-through, quoted at confirmation) PLUS a flat €2.50 third-party cost on every withdrawal; crypto deposits free; EUR bank withdrawals free. Only the BTC/Bitcoin route is modeled v0.43 (network component proxied at the same ~0.00005 BTC typical 2026 reference as Bitvavo, with the €2.50 surcharge folded into the native-unit figure and disclosed in the note); the other 400+ assets use the same dynamic+€2.50 formula but were not individually verified.

sources.name: Bitpanda crypto withdrawal fees (dynamic network pass-through; published-fee tracker skontro.com/exchanges/bitpanda checked 2026-06-10..2026-08-09; coinspeaker real-account review 2026-02-04 confirms no exchange markup)
sources.note: Bitpanda charges the on-chain network fee at cost with no added markup and publishes no fixed table. Snapshot: BTC 0.00000598 (≈$0.47 at tracker prices; ≈$0.46 at the 2026-09-12 $77,298 snapshot used here) checked 2026-06-10; ETH 0.0006 (≈$1.49; ≈$1.51 at $2,512) checked 2026-08-09. Both routes modeled v0.44; other assets float with congestion and were not individually verified. EUR SEPA and GBP FPS fiat withdrawals are free.

sources.name: BISON withdrawal policy (official bisonapp.com/en/costs retrieved 2026-09-05; BISON support article 'Crypto Withdrawal to Your Own Wallet' + per-coin address/minimum overview, verified 2026-09-13)
sources.note: BISON officially advertises cryptocurrency withdrawals to the user's own wallet as FREE OF CHARGE with no separate network-fee line ('Withdrawing cryptocurrencies is free of charge for you' — on-chain network costs are absorbed by EUWAX/Boerse Stuttgart Group, unlike Bitpanda's pass-through model); crypto deposits and SEPA euro deposits/withdrawals are also free. Per-coin technical minimum withdrawal amounts apply (BTC 0.001, ETH 0.01; SOL 0.1, XRP 10, ADA 30, DOGE 100) and withdrawals can be cancelled within 24h while pending. BTC/Bitcoin and ETH/Ethereum routes modeled at 0 native fee v0.45; the other ~54 assets follow the same free policy but were not individually enumerated.
